ImageDescription.value:
Pusher tugboat, LEYNIR - IMO 9126388, leaving the harbor at Reykjavik, Iceland heading out into Faxaflói Bay and a storm coming off Mount Esja on August 13, 2019.
There are two lighthouses at the entrance to Reykjavík Harbor - Reykjavík Norðurgarði (north mole - L4506 shown here) and Reykjavík Ingólfsgarði (south mole - L4508). Both are small pyramidal structures made of corrugated iron and painted yellow with a viewing platform that looks out over Faxaflói Bay and Mt. Esja.
